---
name: Userstory template
about: Create new userstory.
title: USERSTORY- 
labels: 'userstory'
assignees: ''

---

Title
    Short, descriptive title (e.g., “User Registration Flow”)

As a (User Type/Role)
    Describe who the story is about (e.g., “new user,” “admin,” “visitor”).

I want to (Goal)
    Describe what the user wants to do.

So that (Benefit)
    Explain why this feature or action is important for the user.

Acceptance Criteria
    Bullet points outlining what must be true to consider this story “done.”
    Example: “Users can submit their registration details successfully.”
    Example: “Users receive a confirmation email.”

Additional Details (optional)
    Any extra information, constraints, or related tickets.
